kind: Matched single-classification-contrast anchor for predeclared two-contrast heldout fusion
hypothesis: Different pretrained task priors may supply residual information. Strongly regularized two-dimensional log-odds contrasts constrain flexibility versus a generic stack.
admission_gate: Allfiveclassification source folds and hashes/roles verified; no regressor input is used by this separately registered anchor.
method_limit: Honest heldout meta fit within each outertraining partition, not global OOF stacking. No spline predictions enter meta fit because spline was trained on those6k labels.
primary: Single classification log-odds contrast versus repaired Kumo90. Same0.03 new-direction penalty,0.003 main penalty and0.5 shrinkage; no weight grid.
scientific_gate: SCIENTIFIC_GATE.json: allfive component manifests, disjoint roles, artifact hashes and original correction objectives verified before fitting
